atomic_claims.claim: Raw child-output digests and lengths can be offline secret-guessing telemetry, while a doctor still needs to fail closed on undecodable output.

atomic_claims.claim: Windows PID-addressed tree killing is vulnerable to PID reuse and does not prove containment.
atomic_claims.control: Resolve and type every Job/resume API before Job creation; missing/ill-typed APIs are typed containment_unavailable with no child launch. Create an owned kill-on-close Job, start suspended, assign the owned process handle, then resume; setup/close failure is typed and fail closed.

dissent: The prior Payload A was externally rejected: it resolved NtResumeProcess after Job creation and could leak a configured handle if lookup raised AttributeError. The replacement resolves/types all APIs first and closes untransferred handles on post-create setup failure; it still relies on NtResumeProcess solely to eliminate pre-Job user-code execution.

The intermediate candidate used PID-addressed taskkill and retained byte-count/digest output metadata. Those rejected designs remain adverse history only; they are not a property of the current implementation or its receipt.

The 600-second limit is deliberately finite: it is the next minute above 1.75 times the observed 334.026-second controller duration, and a prospective duration of 450 seconds or more requires performance/risk review rather than a silent increase.
No child-derived output text, byte count, digest, tail, or truncation metadata is retained; UTF-8 validity and reader state are the narrowly necessary safe stream evidence.
POSIX process-group cleanup cannot contain a descendant that calls setsid. A held pipe becomes typed output_stream_incomplete; doctor makes no claim to have killed the detached process.
No present-day full doctor result supplies a retroactive verdict for the retained 2026-08-13 adverse failure.

The repository-CI evidence has no independently retained raw transcript or digest and supports only the narrow immutable-R3 gate—not transcript-byte integrity, per-test detail, complete-output proof, independent replay, later Envelope-B exact-head coverage, or superiority.
rollback: Revert the bounded doctor implementation and ADR without deleting the adverse history, focused tests, receipts, dissent, or court record.
